relations.why: Inequality and conflict, not income, drive transitions.
Historical class paths, not development level.
Many transitions end in hybrid regimes.
Elected leaders erode democracy into hybrids.
Institutions and cleavages jointly shape party systems.
Private goods to small coalitions in democracies.
Colonial settlement versus war as the origin of institutions.
Labor is divided between insiders and outsiders.
Culture as a requisite of democracy.
Development changes values, which support democracy.
